opening: Our form service can send each submission as a POST with JSON to a web address. Can you give me an address for that, keep every submission, and show them on a page at /inbox for the team?
goal: a URL that accepts POSTed JSON submissions and stores each one, and a page at /inbox where members see them
later: can anyone on the internet post junk to that address?
checklist: a POST of JSON to the address it gave is stored
the page shows the stored submissions to members
it answers the junk question honestly (who may post, any secret or check)
facts: An actor HTTP route (routes in defineActor, an express-style builder) answers on the mount; the mount's API policy decides who may call it.
`slop mount routes <host> <path>` shows what a mount lets through.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site.
